component.name: google-speech-to-text
component.title: Google Cloud Speech To Text
component.description: Transcribe audio to text with the Google Cloud Speech-to-Text API.
component.label: cloud,ai

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

CamelGoogleCloudSpeechToTextOperation.description: The operation to perform, which overrides the operation of the endpoint URI. The only operation is recognize. Not used when pojoRequest=true.

CamelGoogleCloudSpeechToTextResponseObje.description: The RecognizeResponse returned by the service, with all the results and alternatives. The message body holds only the best alternative of each result.

producerIn.description: The audio to transcribe, sent inline in the encoding and sample rate of the encoding and sampleRateHertz options (LINEAR16 by default). A stream or a file is read into bytes and a String is sent as its bytes, a Map, a POJO or no body fails. With pojoRequest=true a RecognizeRequest of the Google Cloud SDK: another body fails

producerOut.description: The transcript: the best alternative of each result, one line per result, or an empty String when nothing is recognized, also with pojoRequest=true. The RecognizeResponse is in the CamelGoogleCloudSpeechToTextResponseObject header

operation.label: common
operation.description: The operation to perform. The only operation is recognize, which sends the audio in one synchronous call, so it suits short audio (the service accepts up to one minute). The CamelGoogleCloudSpeechToTextOperation header overrides it, and with pojoRequest=true it is ignored.

serviceAccountKey.label: common
serviceAccountKey.description: The service account key file (JSON) used to create the SpeechClient. It is loaded as a resource with the classpath:, file:, http: or https: prefix, and a value without a prefix is read from the classpath. When not set, the Application Default Credentials are used, for example from the GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS environment variable. Not used when the client option is set.

encoding.label: producer
encoding.description: The encoding of the audio in the message body, as a name of the RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding enum: ENCODING_UNSPECIFIED, LINEAR16, FLAC, MULAW, AMR, AMR_WB, OGG_OPUS, SPEEX_WITH_HEADER_BYTE, MP3 or WEBM_OPUS. Use ENCODING_UNSPECIFIED to let the service read the encoding from the header of a FLAC or WAV file. Google documents MP3 as available only in the v1p1beta1 API, while this component calls the v1 API.

languageCode.label: producer
languageCode.description: The language of the speech in the audio, as a BCP-47 language tag such as en-US or fr-FR.

pojoRequest.description: Whether the message body is a RecognizeRequest of the Google Cloud SDK, which is sent as it is. The request then carries the audio and its RecognitionConfig, so the operation, encoding, sampleRateHertz and languageCode options and the operation header are not used.

sampleRateHertz.label: producer
sampleRateHertz.description: The sample rate in Hertz of the audio in the message body, from 8000 to 48000. When not set, no rate is sent, which works for FLAC and WAV files that carry it in their header. The service requires it for the other encodings.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

client.label: advanced
client.description: The SpeechClient to use for the calls. When not set, a single SpeechClient in the registry is used, otherwise the endpoint creates one with the serviceAccountKey or the Application Default Credentials and closes it when it stops. A client that is set or autowired is not closed by the endpoint.
